mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS id, w.fund_code AS fundCode, f.fund_name AS fundName, w.remark AS remark, w.create_time AS createTime, nav.unit_nav AS latestNav, nav.nav_date AS latestNavDate, nav.daily_return_rate AS dailyReturnRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM caishen_fund_alert a WHERE a.watch_id = w.id) AS alertCount FROM caishen_fund_watch w LEFT JOIN caishen_fund f ON f.fund_code = w.fund_code LEFT JOIN caishen_fund_nav nav ON nav.fund_code = w.fund_code AND nav.nav_date = (SELECT MAX(n2.nav_date) FROM caishen_fund_nav n2 WHERE n2.fund_code = w.fund_code) WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.create_time DESC
